# PawBiotix

> PawBiotix is a natural dog probiotic supplement with gut-friendly strains and supporting ingredients formulated to support canine digestion, immunity, and healthy stools for dogs of every breed, age, and size. Sold as a one-time purchase with a 60-day money-back guarantee.

## Key facts
- Product: PawBiotix dog probiotic powder
- Format: daily powder, sprinkled on food
- Ingredients: 13 gut-supporting ingredients (probiotics, prebiotics, superfoods, botanicals)
- Guarantee: 60-day money-back
- Packages: 2, 3, and 6 bottles (6-bottle includes 3 free bonus guides and free US shipping)
